existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: ExplanationOfBenefit has multiple local hard breaking changes between R4 and R6. The top migration concerns are required `patient` becoming required `subject`, body-site and process-note serialization shape changes, and R6 data that cannot be round-tripped to R4 because requiredness was relaxed and choice/reference domains were widened. Confidence is high for computable StructureDefinition differences, with moderate uncertainty about official migration intent and terminology expansion details.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: The main themes are element identity changes, representation changes, and model widening. R4 data generally needs active transforms rather than field-for-field copying. R6-to-R4 conversion is harder for new or wider content: Group subjects, added request targets, broader supportingInfo.value[x] types, omitted insurer/provider/insurance/productOrService, and added financial/review fields require policy decisions or extensions.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for local snapshot deltas because both assigned StructureDefinitions were present and directly compared. Confidence is lower for business justification, prevalence, and exact terminology validation because no official diff, ConceptMap, narrative ballot rationale, terminology-server expansion, or real-world corpus was available.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
ExplanationOfBenefit keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 7 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 1 potential hard break(s), 4 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 89/100, producing migration shape `major-model-remodel`, major migration `Yes`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

8 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Required patient was replaced by required subject with an expanded Patient-or-Group target
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 JSON with required `patient` lacks required R6 `subject`; generated APIs, FHIRPath, authorization, and mapping code also need path changes, and Group subjects create R6-to-R4 loss.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: careTeam.responsible and careTeam.qualification were removed; specialty was added as a partial replacement
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 care-team entries containing `responsible` or `qualification` use paths absent from R6; preserving `responsible` requires an extension or other policy.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: diagnosis.packageCode moved from each diagnosis to root diagnosisRelatedGroup
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: the nested R4 path is absent in R6; multiple distinct R4 nested codes cannot be automatically represented by one R6 root value.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: supportingInfo.timing[x] replaced date with dateTime and added Timing
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `timingDate` is not an R6 choice property; R6 `timingTiming` or high-precision dateTime values create reverse-conversion policy issues.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: item and addItem bodySite changed from a CodeableConcept plus subSite fields to repeating backbone structures
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `bodySite` objects and sibling `subSite` arrays do not match the R6 array/backbone shape; R6 multiple sites or BodyStructure references are not losslessly representable in R4.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: processNote.type changed from required-bound code to CodeableConcept and processNote.text changed from string to markdown
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: a primitive `processNote.type` string is not the R6 CodeableConcept shape; generated enum/string accessors change, and richer R6 CodeableConcepts may not reduce to one R4 code.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: item.adjudication.value decimal was removed and replaced by adjudication.quantity Quantity
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 decimal `value` property is not accepted on the R6 adjudication component; R6 Quantity unit/system/comparator metadata cannot be represented by a bare R4 decimal.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: processNote.language binding strengthened from preferred common languages to required all-languages
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances with local-only or text-only note language concepts may fail required-binding validation in R6, depending on terminology-validator behavior.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Several R4 required billing fields became optional in R6
topFindings.affectedPath: ExplanationOfBenefit.insurance / insurer / provider / item.productOrService and nested productOrService elements
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen: old R4-derived code may assume non-null insurer, provider, insurance, and product/service after validation; R6-to-R4 loss occurs when valid R6 instances omit R4-required content.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Multiple reference targets were widened, creating R6-to-R4 representability risks
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: new R6 reference targets are not legal R4 targets, but R4 references are preserved in R6.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
